correctness.rationale: The centralizer-of-a-full-cycle embedding and semiregularity are derived from the pair-successor map. The quotient edge orbit parameter (A,B,h) counts exactly m²d edges, so summing their phase changes forces 1≡m²d(d−1)/2 (mod d); only d=2, m odd survives. A connected Eulerian quotient multigraph with total odd voltage lifts to a single de Bruijn Euler tour with its half-shift involution, establishing exact sharpness. The nonperiodic branch uses the precisely stated uniqueness theorem. The finite checker independently tests all n=2,3 cycles and constructed n=6 and n=10 cycles; this is not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: A natural newly defined class of finite nonassociative groupoids is shown to have unexpectedly tiny full automorphism groups (at most two), with a sharp mod-four existence threshold. The quotient-voltage obstruction works uniformly for all cardinalities and the Euler construction attains every admissible size. This is a structural classification, rather than an incidental example or routine numerical corollary.
